verdict.rationale: Docs show a draft vs published flow model with a review/approval gate for sensitive flows (PUBLISH_SENSITIVE_FLOW_ACCESS, 'Request approval') and audit logs of agent actions, which cover part of 'review' and change-gating. However there is no documented version-history browser or explicit rollback-to-previous-version feature. Missing for 10: explicit version history UI, ability to revert/rollback to a prior published version, and independent confirmation of this workflow.
